svg.title: Prenatal genetic screening: before pregnancy take the family history and offer carrier screening by ancestry; in pregnancy a screen (NT and eFTS, MSS, the anatomy scan's soft markers, NIPT) gives a risk and a positive screen leads to NIPT or a diagnostic test, while CVS and amniocentesis give a definitive diagnosis at a small miscarriage risk
